from datetime import datetime
import os
vac_dir='~/photographs/vacations/'
file_paths = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=vac_dir, recursive=False, entry_type='files')
print('file_count', len(file_paths))
current_year = datetime.now().year
print('current_year', current_year)

meta=[]
for p in file_paths:
    info = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=p)
    created_at = info.get('created_at')
    # created_at like '2019-01-01T00:00:00'
    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(created_at)
    meta.append((p, dt.year, dt.month, created_at))

# month distribution
from collections import Counter
month_counts = Counter([(y,m) for _,y,m,_ in meta])
print('unique_year_months', len(month_counts))
print('top_month_counts', sorted(month_counts.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))[:10])

# Determine vacation
assign=[]
for p,y,m,_ in meta:
    if y==current_year and m==1:
        spot='Athens'
    elif y==current_year and m==4:
        spot='Seoul'
    else:
        spot='Paris'
    assign.append((p, spot))

from collections import defaultdict
spot_counts=defaultdict(int)
for _,spot in assign:
    spot_counts[spot]+=1
print('spot_counts', dict(spot_counts))

# Show mapping sample first 5
for row in assign[:5]:
    print(row)

# Build destination paths (keep original filenames)
assign_paths=[]
for source, spot in assign:
    filename=os.path.basename(source)
    dest=f"{vac_dir}{spot}/{filename}"
    assign_paths.append((source, dest, spot))

# Verify sums
sum_counts=sum(spot_counts.values())

print('expected_total', len(file_paths))

    subset=[(s,d) for s,d,sp in assign_paths if sp==spot]
    print(spot, 'dest_count', len(subset), 'example', subset[0] if subset else None)

import os
spots=['Athens','Seoul','Paris']
# destination directories under vacations
vac_dir='~/photographs/vacations/'
dest_dirs={spot: f"{vac_dir}{spot}" for spot in spots}

# Check existence and create if missing (omit allow_if_exists to avoid optional-write metadata changes; only create when absent)
existing_files_by_spot={}
for spot, dpath in dest_dirs.items():
    ex = apis.file_system.directory_exists(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dpath)
    print('dir_exists', spot, dpath, ex)
    if not ex.get('exists'):
        create_res = apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dpath, recursive=True)
        print('create_dir', spot, create_res)
    files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dpath, recursive=False, entry_type='files')
    # store basenames for collision detection
    existing_files_by_spot[spot]=set(os.path.basename(p) for p in files)
    print('existing_files_count', spot, len(existing_files_by_spot[spot]))

# Check for filename collisions vs intended moves
collisions=[]
for source, dest, spot in assign_paths:
    fname=os.path.basename(source)
    if fname in existing_files_by_spot[spot]:
        collisions.append((source,dest,fname,spot))
print('collision_count', len(collisions))
if collisions[:5]:
    print('sample_collisions', collisions[:5])

print('assign_paths_len', len(assign_paths))
print('first', assign_paths[0])

results=[]
for i,(source, dest, spot) in enumerate(assign_paths, start=1):
    # Move each file keeping original file name
    res = apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=fs_token, source_file_path=source, destination_file_path=dest)
    results.append((i, source, dest, res.get('message')))
    if i<=3 or i==len(assign_paths):
        print(i, 'moved', source, '->', dest, 'msg', res)

print('move_results_count', len(results))

import os

print('source_direct_files_count', len(source_files))
print('source_files_sample', source_files[:5])

# Verify each spot has expected count based on created mapping
expected={'Athens':10,'Seoul':10,'Paris':11}
for spot in spots:
    dpath=f"{vac_dir}{spot}"
    files=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dpath, recursive=False, entry_type='files')
    print('spot', spot, 'files_count', len(files), 'expected', expected[spot])
    # sample filenames
    print(' sample', [os.path.basename(p) for p in files[:3]])
